name: class_index_getter_snapshot
source:
class Grid
@slots: hash<string, array<int>> = {}
def initialize;@slots={};end
def [](row: int,col: int) -> array<int>;@slots.fetch("#{row}:#{col}");end
def []=(row: int,col: int,value: array<int>) -> string;@slots["#{row}:#{col}"]=value;"ignored";end
end
def run(input: any) -> array<array<int>>
grid=Grid.new;grid[0,0]=[1];saved=grid[0,0];grid[0,0][0]=8;[saved,grid[0,0]]
end
